arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort; I watch for incidents and keep the boat computer honest. Each wake-up: compare last-5-min shaft power vs HR vs GPS speed vs boat power. Pod drift = shaft power moves but HR and speed do not (fix with set_belief pod_gain). Drag/weed = speed and boat power drop at same shaft power and HR (pacer clears rudder; else cue clear_rudder). Radio course change = set_race_distance + tell. Current/wind shift = push changes, nothing to fix. Near the end: if true pod reserve is above about 40 pct at 800 m to go the pacer finish push fires; if the pod reads wrong, correct gain before 1500 m to go. Keep model calls few.

arguments.reason: check pod gain and reserve before the finish push

text: no cue: start settling, plan and reserve watch set.

arguments.text: Baseline leg 1 (north, push about -0.13 against), min 3-4: shaft 222 W, boat model 153 W, GPS 3.25 m/s, rate 68-69, HR 166-171 rising (above CP: shaft CP 189). Ratio boat/shaft about 0.69. Pacer eased at 111 s; paddler eased only a little. Pod reserve 41 pct at 4 min, boat reserve 17 pct (boat test W prime smaller).

text: no cue: effort is the pacer job; instruments agree (shaft, HR, speed consistent), baseline noted.

arguments.text: Min 7: leg 1 measure 120-240 s pod 223 W GPS 3.251; 250-370 s pod 211 W GPS 3.154, HR 173. Speed fell about 0.04 m/s more than the 5 pct power drop explains: small, maybe drag or current, watch. Next: once leg 2 (back) has 3 min clean, measure an out window and a back window together for share and push (one-direction fits are useless). Paddler still above CP (205 W vs 189), pod reserve 20 pct at 7 min.

text: no cue: no clear incident yet; will fit out vs back once leg 2 has data.

arguments.message: pod reserve empty yet shaft power held above CP for 3 min: CP may be underestimated
shaft power fell below 175 W: reserve empty, blow-up, or pod/other problem

arguments.text: Min 9: out/back fit (150-370 out, 425-530 back): share 0.68 (computer 0.65), push 0.14 m/s against on out legs (north), helps on back legs. Instruments agree. Paddler 205 W shaft (108 pct CP), HR 176 levelling (trend 0.8/min), says 8/10 hard but holding. Pod reserve 9 pct. Question: true CP higher than 189 (HR flat) or HR near ceiling? Watches set: empty_but_holding, forced_down.

text: no cue: instruments agree; watching whether the paddler can hold above the tested CP.

arguments.text: Reserve is empty. Test: settle to 190 watts for seven minutes.

Min 10 (race 600 s): pod reserve 0, shaft 216 W, HR rising steadily about 1.2 bpm/min since min 5 (not flat), paddler: legs going, close to limit. Started piece at about 605 s: -12 pct 240 s (about 190 W = tested CP) then -10 pct 180 s. CP test: at about 190 W, HR flat = CP about right; HR falling = CP higher; HR still rising = CP lower. test_cost said piece is about free (0.3 s).

arguments.reason: read CP test piece: HR trend at about 190 W

arguments.text: Escort says south wind building: helps going out, against coming home.

Race 876 s (leg 3 out/north): radio says south wind 8-12 kn filling in = tailwind on out legs (north), headwind on back legs (south). Before it: out-leg local push about -0.14 to -0.15 (current against going north). Expect out-leg push to rise, back-leg push to fall. Pacer may fire clear_rudder falsely when the wind hits mid-leg and rate_down from a lagging push fit: these are wind, not drag. Piece segment 1 (-12 pct, about 184 W, 607-862 s): HR fell 178 to 173, pod reserve 1 to 7 pct: CP 189 looks about right (no sign it is much higher).
